claims.statement: The constrained objective couples the outcome term with the alignment term, the invariance penalty and the programme penalty under three weights
The discrimination of the constrained model must stay at or above a pre-declared floor, and an epoch that would breach the floor is reverted
Stage 1 holds the encoders fixed and fits the outcome head, the programme decoder and the interval head on the outcome term and the programme penalty
Stage 2 releases the encoders and takes the outcome, alignment and invariance steps in turn within each epoch
A mini-batch is drawn with modality dropout applied per observation, so any combination of streams a site can acquire is estimable
Early stopping is taken on the development split only
The programme is the support of the decoder, the signs come from its coefficients, and the effects and intervals come from the interval head validated leave-one-site-out
The alignment term pulls the fused region representation towards the metabolite block and matches their second-moment structure, because matching alone admits axes with no metabolic meaning
Two readings of the invariance penalty are implemented: a variance penalty on the between-site covariance and an adversarial penalty through a reversed gradient
Sparsity is imposed by a group penalty over metabolically coherent blocks rather than element by element

claims.note: the nominal level is printed as 0.90 in the table columns; the sentence that describes the head also prints a coverage word the table does not use, so the table value governs
claims.statement: The interval head targets a fixed nominal reliability, exact under no shift and measured again under shift

claims.note: the retrospective and silent arms are held by the participating institutions
claims.statement: Nine predictors are compared across internal, external and low-resource partitions on discrimination, calibration, Brier score and decision-curve net benefit
Nine configurations remove or replace one component of the objective, including two tier-zero controls
Removing both constraint terms costs more than the sum of the individual removals, which is the super-additivity that carries the architectural reading
A model fitted on one region is evaluated on each other region, and the pooled site-invariant row is reported even where it exceeds a diagonal cell
A probe trained on the same representations predicts site and region identity, and the constrained configurations suppress that prediction while keeping discrimination
Three arms are read on the same cases, and the combination beats both single arms while the overcall rate falls

claims.note: panel A is not evaluable by design; the annotation columns are marked rather than filled
claims.statement: Three open-tier resources carry no response annotation and six annotated series carry the auxiliary comparison
The model transfers without task-specific re-parameterisation to two adjacent tumour types and one non-colorectal setting, and the advantage decays away from the primary task
The fitting-fraction curve saturates early while the supervision-fraction curve is still rising, and neither curve is monotone to the reported precision
Programme coherence is the agreement between the emitted programme and the metabolite covariance structure of the held-out supervised region
Seed aggregation moves discrimination slightly while helping calibration and narrowing intervals; the regime ensemble is the auxiliary comparison
Empirical interval coverage is reported next to the mean interval width
Differences in discrimination are assessed with the paired DeLong test over the pre-specified comparison set
The Holm correction is applied inside one family of five pre-declared contrasts and nothing outside it is corrected
Confidence intervals come from bootstrapping at the patient level
The null band used to read the ablation table is T = 0.003 as a fraction
The primary limb of the success criterion is an equivalence claim against a pre-declared margin of 0.015 in the area under the curve
The criterion is conjunctive: parity within the margin on the primary partition and superiority on the external partition
Entering the oxygenation proxy as a covariate leaves three programmes with incremental value, removes the hypoxia-linked one, and leaves the rest inconclusive
The complete response rate is 19.4 per cent with a 95 per cent interval of [18.2, 20.6], rule-in statements are reported as positive predictive values
Partitioning is at the patient level, sites A-E develop and sites F and G hold out, and no cross-setting number comes from a random patient split inside the sites

claims.note: no assay is run in this release; the design and its guards are implemented
claims.statement: The in-vitro arm uses a multi-dose schedule with the perturbation present before and during irradiation, reports clonogenic survival as a sensitisation ratio, and fixes the anticipated bands before the model output is reviewed
The mechanistic secondary output is stable-isotope-resolved flux, read for whether the process advances as anticipated
A line that fails the programme is counted as a failed prediction rather than replaced by a more convenient line

probe_outcomes.detail: the margin, null band, family size and coverage target are carried from the configuration into the objects that use them
no patient straddles two layers, no holdout site appears in the development arm, a staged archive reads back unchanged, and an absent archive is reported rather than substituted
every stream arrives with the shape its configuration declares and one row per observation, and the presence indicator covers every configured modality
all four terms of Eq. (1) evaluate to finite scalars and the backward pass reaches the encoder parameters
a step moves the parameters and lowers the loss on the batch the gradient came from
60 steps on one batch drive the loss down by more than half, so the forward, loss, backward and step path is connected
a checkpoint restores the exact weights into a freshly built model and carries the seed and the epoch it was written at
both stages complete, the feasibility ledger records a verdict per stage-two epoch, and a checkpoint is written
the penalty is lower once the site means are removed and differs again when the site labels are shuffled, so it responds to the setting rather than to the scale alone
the reversed branch leaves the forward value untouched and negates the gradient exactly
the matching half separates a row permutation while staying non-negative, and the second-moment half separates an axis permutation whose row pairs are untouched
a stream the site cannot acquire is never enabled and every row keeps at least one stream
every emitted programme keeps between one and four entries per block, carries unit signs, and reports an ordered interval for each supported programme
the coverage read-out equals an independent count on the same intervals and halving the width lowers coverage, so the column responds to the intervals it describes
the released area under the curve agrees to machine precision with a concordant-pair count and with an empirical-curve integral on the same scores and ties
the paired contrast reproduces both areas from the structural components and agrees with an independent pair count, and the patient bootstrap resamples whole patients
the step-down adjustment matches an independent implementation value for value and rejects the same contrasts
the parity difference is inside the margin, the conjunctive criterion needs both limbs, and a margin narrower than its own interval is reported as unresolvable

the rule maps a gain above the band to retained, a non-positive gain to lost and a gain inside the band to inconclusive; on measured columns, the three carrying signal above the proxy are retained and the three carrying none are not

summary.substitution_reading: the programme is partly, but not wholly, a re-description of oxygenation

probe_outcomes.detail: a two-dose schedule and a protocol frozen after the model review are both refused, and the sensitisation ratio is read against the pre-declared band
every labelling shift whose direction matches the emitted sign is counted, and a shift against the sign is not
each removal row zeroes exactly the term it names, the metabolite control permutes rows inside a region without changing the multiset, and the site control preserves the label histogram
a representation carrying site offsets is separated from one that is not, the constrained row loses most of that excess, and the transfer matrix reports a retention factor below one off the diagonal

the three arms order as reported and the combination calls fewer negatives positive; the saturation reduction depends on the tolerance in the expected direction, and both curves show the reported non-monotone step while the lower block is reported as unsaturated
the list covers the three open-tier resources, the six annotated series and the extra platform matrices, and every URL is https
none of the public resources could be reached from this machine, so no count could be checked against the table
the training entry point runs a configured job from a config file and writes its run header, fit summary and checkpoints
